parsed.review_summary: The corrected rationale addresses all four error targets: (1) it removes the factual claim that authors can pinpoint the exact part, noting the comment lacks a concrete location; (2) it corrects the rubric misapplication by clarifying that grounding only reaches the educated-guess level, not fully grounded; (3) it correctly maps specificity as met but overall alignment to a lower rubric level; and (4) it corrects the score mapping to match the appropriate rubric band rather than the top level. The edit preserves the valid reasoning about specificity being satisfied and does not directly state a numeric score or gold label.
